sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a "Length info - Live status" section to the "Length" column's unique-values (📊) dropdown, sibling to "Length info - Deviation": surfaces the same live/studio classification that section already computes internally as its own two directly checkable entries ("🎙️ Live recording" / "⚪ Not live"), only shown when the page has a recognized live-flag column. Checking "🎙️ Live recording" narrows the table and highlights the word "live" in each matching row's Attributes cell. Shares the existing `sa_enable_length_deviation_section` setting (now covering both sections).
